_readme: Every child-facing Slovenian text of Detektivska pisarna (solo game), exported from solo/index.html.
Keep the wording exactly; » « are Slovenian quotes. **word** in sentences is shown bold (a name).
ui.UI_AUDIO: instructions, hints and messages (key = what it is for: how* = step instruction, h* = hint, *Done = step done).
ui.BRIEF: instruction cards per step [icon, title, UI_AUDIO key of the how-line, case field with the puzzle note].
ui.STEP_LABEL: the main button that leads to the next step. ui.RANKS: m = boy, f = girl form.
seasons.pokal: the season to design first, all 6 cases with every step, puzzle, newspaper (paper, caught, excuse), corkboard card and letter.
seasons.galeb.cases g2: an extra case for the ✉️ cipher puzzle, which pokal does not use.
adventures: every adventure (title, icon, mystery, teaser, newspaper masthead); coming: announced seasons.
ui.screen_strings_raw: other literal strings from the screen templates, extracted automatically (may hold small fragments).
In a case: role "evidence" = the proof, "clear" + clears = an alibi that crosses that suspect off, "partial" = the culprit's own claim, "distractor" = a decoy.
